cohort: The study included 218 women, 98 (44.9%) of Bedouin origin and 120 (55.1%) of Jewish origin, who delivered singletons.
finding: Better mother-infant bonding was found among Bedouin women delivering male infants compared to female infants, with no such association in Jewish women.
cross-section timing: Postpartum, at the time of bonding questionnaire administration (specific timing relative to birth not mentioned).
